WITH rj_orders AS (
  SELECT
    oi.freight_value,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp
  FROM orders.order_items oi
  JOIN orders.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01'
),
window_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n_items,
    SUM(CASE WHEN freight_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null_freight,
    SUM(CASE WHEN freight_value IS NOT NULL AND (freight_value < 0 OR freight_value > 1000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_extreme_freight,
    AVG(freight_value) AS avg_freight
  FROM rj_orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-08-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-09-01'
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n_items,
    SUM(CASE WHEN freight_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_null_freight,
    SUM(CASE WHEN freight_value IS NOT NULL AND (freight_value < 0 OR freight_value > 1000) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_extreme_freight,
    AVG(freight_value) AS avg_freight
  FROM rj_orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-08-01'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(w.avg_freight, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(b.avg_freight, 4) AS baseline,
  w.n_items AS window_items,
  b.n_items AS baseline_items,
  w.n_null_freight AS window_null_freight,
  b.n_null_freight AS baseline_null_freight,
  w.n_extreme_freight AS window_extreme_freight,
  b.n_extreme_freight AS baseline_extreme_freight
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b;
